items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Shearing maybe? [INTERVIEWEE] No. The other — Terry, the other vibraphonist.

ctx.x: I don’t know what his story was. And Mulligan was all business. And George Duvivier was playing with Mulligan. So what happened, oh yeah that was the first week. The second week they had Calvin Jackson, the pianist. He had written for the studios and he was a fine arranger in Hollywood and then he went back up to Canada. He is a fine pianist. And then they had the little girl that played vibes with — her name was Terry something — she played vibes with—
No. The other — Terry, the other vibraphonist.
